text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! Training's over now, so... 
wanna go somewhere nice with Maya??"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! There's a spot where you 
can see such a suuuper sparkly night view—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho... Huh? It's Mayano~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Teio-chan! Yahoo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I was just looking for you! I wanted to 
let you know I might be home late today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ Coming home late, how bold~! 
Teio-chan is so grown-up~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Watching the President's race just 
now really made me want to run!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In Mayano terms, it was kinda like... 
sparkling, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! I totally get it! The President's 
running style is just so cool, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm, I think I might actually be 
getting kind of excited...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, forget the night view! 
Maya's in the mood to sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehe, that's my Trainer-chan for ya!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then let's run together! It'll fire me up 
way more that way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! Mayano, taking off☆

Mayano Top Gun powered through her extra 
training with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! Exactly! Giving your skin a rest 
gives you that glowing, radiant skin, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Maya's gonna recharge her sparkle 
with all the sparkle from the night view~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm off then~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be back before curfew~~!

Enjoying the night view with Mayano Top 
Gun, I was able to give my body a nice, 
relaxing break.
